blocks.text: Japan guard Yuki Kawamura was on Monday named to the training camp roster of the San Diego Clippers, the NBA G League affiliate of the Los Angeles Clippers. The NBA club signed the 25-year-old to a non-guaranteed Exhibit 10 preseason contract in August to allow him to compete for a spot on their opening-day roster, but waived him on Oct. 12. The San Diego Clippers will host the Valley Suns on Nov. 6 in their NBA G League season opener. Japan’s key player at the 2024 Paris Olympics, Kawamura made his NBA debut with the Memphis Grizzlies the subsequent season on […]...
